description: roles run as Orca workers: the driver starts each dispatch with `orca orchestration worker-start` and collects it with `arbor.py sync`; codeg MCP, bind / collect and the sync-delegation hook are gone
changelog: The only executor type is now `orca`. `arbor.py run` assembles the prompt, writes a task spec (dispatch header plus `Prompt:` and `Report:` pointers) and starts the role itself as a supervised Orca worker in the dispatch's worktree (`orca orchestration worker-start --spec-file ... --worktree path:<worktree> --agent <agent>`); it answers `needs=worker`. The worker writes its complete reply to the `Report:` file (`.arbor/.runtime/replies/<task>/d-NNN.md`) and reports `worker_done`; Orca wakes the main agent, which runs `arbor.py sync`: it reads each pending worker with `orca orchestration worker-show`, collects the settled ones through the unchanged validation, reports workers that wait for a person, fails workers that exited without reporting and stops workers past the executor timeout (`sync --wait <duration>` polls). `arbor.py bind` and `arbor.py collect` are removed, as are the codeg-mcp executor, `assistant` / `assistant_ids` / `agent_type`, the PostToolUse hook sync-delegation.py and its entries in .claude/settings.json and .codex/hooks.json. `executors.<name>` takes `command` (the Orca CLI), `agent`, `model`, `effort`, `keep_open` and per-role overrides under `roles:`. task.json `mcp_pending` is now `workers`; request records moved from .arbor/.runtime/delegations/ to .arbor/.runtime/workers/; next --json says `needs: worker`, `pending_workers`, `orca_dispatch`. Task, partition and integration worktrees are registered in Orca as child workspaces of the checkout they were cut from (`orca worktree set --parent-worktree`, display only).

migrationGuide: Collect or abandon every pending codeg delegation before updating: a 0.9 request cannot be collected by 0.10. Run `arbor update --migrate` (deletes driver/mcp.py and the sync-delegation.py hooks, rewrites the hook settings). In .arbor/config.yaml replace the `executors:` section: `default: orca` and an `orca:` block with `type: orca`, `command` (the Orca CLI; on macOS /Applications/Orca.app/Contents/Resources/bin/orca when `orca` is not on PATH), `agent` (codex, claude, omp, ...), optional `model` / `effort` / `keep_open` and per-role overrides under `roles:`; drop `assistant`, `assistant_ids` and `agent_type`. In Orca: add the repository (`orca repo add`), show non-Orca worktrees for it (`orca repo set --repo path:<repo> --external-worktree-visibility show`), set each agent's permission mode under Settings > Agents so workers do not stop on prompts, and drive every task from an agent that runs inside Orca (the coordinator identity comes from the Orca terminal). The codeg `arbor-*` assistants are no longer used.
